name: Server rack + one room (data link v1.2)
description: Full 3D voxel scene. Navy-purple cabinet with green light accents, bottom-shelf data cable physically connected to the monitor. Green outbound and blue inbound pulses; only rack light accents and the visible crystal face blink blue on receipt; overhead lamp, monitor lettering, ASCI ART wall neon and floor perimeter LEDs blink green on computer receipt. Opaque walls occlude the glow.
